description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Amended Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2234/20 dated 03rd June 2021 is hereby repealed and replaced (Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, specifically repealing and replacing previous regulations regarding foreign exchange for investments in International Sovereign Bonds. This constitutes legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes). Although a minister is named, this is not primarily about government personnel or structure but about establishing legal regulations.
